definitions.definition: gasoline; fuel. Also the hooky party energy of the reggaeton classic.

examples.es: ¿A ti te gusta la gasolina?
examples.en: You like gasoline?

definitions.definition: dumb; lame; corny. Used for weak jokes or silly behavior.

examples.es: Tú me tiras unos chistes demasiado mongos.
examples.en: You throw some way-too-lame jokes at me.

definitions.definition: knife; a blade used for cutting

examples.es: Pásame el cuchillo pa' cortar el pollo.
examples.en: Pass me the knife to cut the chicken.

examples.es: No salgas sin tu cuchillo, mijo.
examples.en: Don't go out without your knife, kid.

definitions.definition: cool; nice; awesome

examples.es: Le enseñé un jueguito chévere.
examples.en: I showed them a cool little game.

examples.es: Ese suéter te quedó muy chévere.
examples.en: That sweater looks really good on you.

definitions.definition: to pitch (a ball)

examples.es: Él le picheó la pelota tan rápido que ni la pude ver.
examples.en: He pitched the ball so fast I couldn’t even see it.

definitions.definition: to brush off; to dismiss what someone says

examples.es: Se molestó tanto con él que ella empezó a pichear todo lo que decía.
examples.en: She got so mad at him that she started brushing off everything he said.

definitions.definition: to get upset; to get annoyed / in a mood

examples.es: Cuando le di a mi hija la muñequita, se quilló conmigo porque era del color equivocado.
examples.en: When I gave my daughter the little doll, she got mad at me because it was the wrong color.

definitions.definition: thing; stuff. A catch-all for an object, situation, or "whatever that was".

examples.es: ¿Qué era la vaina que tú llevaste a la fiesta el otro día?
examples.en: What was that thing you brought to the party the other day?

definitions.definition: to vent; to get something off my chest. To unburden yourself by talking it out.

examples.es: Necesito desahogarme un poco, porque llevo días con esa vaina en la cabeza.
examples.en: I need to vent a little, because I've had that thing stuck in my head for days.

definitions.definition: so-and-so; whatshisname; a John Doe. Stand-in for an unnamed (or unnamed-on-purpose) person.

examples.es: Yo no voy a cambiar de opinión porque fulano piensa diferente.
examples.en: I'm not gonna change my mind because fulano thinks differently.

definitions.definition: money; cash. Street slang for dough, especially when you're talking about having (or not having) any.

examples.es: No tengo cuarto pa' salir esta noche.
examples.en: I don't have money to go out tonight.

definitions.definition: room; bedroom. The space you sleep in or hang out in at home.

examples.es: Entra a mi cuarto, que te quiero mostrar una vaina.
examples.en: Come into my room, I want to show you something.

definitions.definition: fourth. The ordinal number after third (el cuarto, la cuarta).

examples.es: Él llegó en el cuarto puesto de la carrera.
examples.en: He finished in fourth place in the race.

definitions.definition: mistake; failure; flop. When something goes wrong or doesn't work out.

examples.es: Eso fue un fracaso total — me equivoqué de camino y llegué tarde.
examples.en: That was a total mistake — I took the wrong way and showed up late.

definitions.definition: a rush; hurry-scurry; scramble. The chaotic hustle when everyone's running around trying to get something done.

examples.es: Había un corre corre en la casa antes de que llegaran los invitados.
examples.en: There was a crazy rush around the house before the guests arrived.

definitions.definition: to stay up late; to lose sleep. When you can't (or won't) go to bed.

examples.es: Me desvelé viendo una serie y ahora no doy más.
examples.en: I stayed up late watching a show and now I'm wiped.

definitions.definition: to cuddle; to hug with care. Soft affection — holding someone like you mean it.

examples.es: Ven pa'cá que te quiero apapachar un ratico.
examples.en: Come here, I want to cuddle you for a bit.

definitions.definition: to find out; to figure out. Digging until you know what's going on.

examples.es: Voy a averiguar quién tiró esa vaina.
examples.en: I'm going to find out who threw that thing.

definitions.definition: hopefully; I hope so. A wish that something turns out right.

examples.es: Ojalá no llueva el día de la fiesta.
examples.en: Hopefully it doesn't rain on the day of the party.

definitions.definition: to miss (someone/something). That ache when they're not around.

examples.es: Te echo de menos desde que te mudaste.
examples.en: I've missed you since you moved away.

definitions.definition: to put up with; to endure. Holding on through something annoying or hard.

examples.es: No aguanto más ese ruido de la calle.
examples.en: I can't put up with that street noise anymore.

definitions.definition: suddenly; all of a sudden. When something hits out of nowhere.

examples.es: De repente se apagó la luz en toda la cuadra.
examples.en: All of a sudden the lights went out on the whole block.

definitions.definition: barely; hardly; just. Almost not — or only just now.

examples.es: Apenas llegué y ya me están pidiendo favores.
examples.en: I barely got here and they're already asking me for favors.

definitions.definition: to regret; to feel sorry. Wishing you'd done it differently.

examples.es: Me arrepentí de no haber ido a la boda.
examples.en: I regretted not going to the wedding.

definitions.definition: to dare; to have the guts. Doing the thing even when you're nervous.

examples.es: ¿Te atreves a probar esa comida tan picante?
examples.en: Do you dare try that super spicy food?

definitions.definition: to not matter; whatever. When you genuinely don't care either way.

examples.es: Me da igual si vamos hoy o mañana.
examples.en: I don't care if we go today or tomorrow.

definitions.definition: to stay; to remain. Hanging back instead of leaving — or ending up a certain way.

examples.es: Me quedé en casa porque estaba lloviendo mucho.
examples.en: I stayed home because it was raining hard.

definitions.definition: lingering at the table after a meal. Talking, laughing, not rushing to clear up.

examples.es: La sobremesa duró más que la cena misma.
examples.en: The after-dinner chat lasted longer than dinner itself.

definitions.definition: to get up early. Beating the sunrise — on purpose or because life said so.

examples.es: Tuvi que madrugar pa' coger la guagua a tiempo.
examples.en: I had to get up early to catch the bus on time.

definitions.definition: to make the most of; to take advantage of (an opportunity). Not wasting the moment.

examples.es: Aprovecha que está barato y compra dos.
examples.en: Take advantage of how cheap it is and buy two.

definitions.definition: to deserve; to be worth. Earning something — or being worth the effort.

examples.es: Tú mereces un descanso después de esa semana.
examples.en: You deserve a break after that week.

definitions.definition: hustle; busy grind. The nonstop running around of a packed day.

examples.es: Con este ajetreo no me queda tiempo ni pa' comer.
examples.en: With this hustle I don't even have time to eat.

definitions.definition: to clear your head; to clear up (weather/mind). Getting space so things feel lighter.

examples.es: Salí a caminar pa' despejarme un poco.
examples.en: I went for a walk to clear my head a bit.

definitions.definition: to lend a hand; to help out. Jumping in when someone needs backup.

examples.es: ¿Me echas una mano con estas cajas?
examples.en: Can you lend me a hand with these boxes?

definitions.definition: to catch; to snag; to get. Grabbing a ride, catching someone, or scoring something.

examples.es: Pillé un uber rapidito afuera del colmado.
examples.en: I caught a quick Uber outside the corner store.

definitions.definition: bus. The public ride that gets you across town (Caribbean Spanish).

examples.es: La guagua se llenó y me tocó ir de pie.
examples.en: The bus filled up and I had to go standing.

definitions.definition: girl; girlfriend. Street word for a young woman / your girl (Caribbean).

examples.es: Esa jeva es bien chévere, de verdad.
examples.en: That girl is really cool, for real.

definitions.definition: messing around; chaos; a joke of a situation. Playful disorder — or when things get out of hand.

examples.es: Deja el relajo y ponte serio un momento.
examples.en: Quit messing around and get serious for a second.

definitions.definition: to deal with; to hustle through. Handling a problem the hard way until it moves.

examples.es: Tengo que bregar con ese papeleo mañana.
examples.en: I have to deal with that paperwork tomorrow.

definitions.definition: trash can; garbage bin. Where the basura goes (Puerto Rico / Caribbean).

examples.es: Tira eso al zafacón, por favor.
examples.en: Throw that in the trash can, please.

definitions.definition: a little bit; a tiny bit. Dominican for "un poquito".

examples.es: Échame un chin más de café.
examples.en: Pour me a little more coffee.

definitions.definition: outside; outdoors. Not in here — out there.

examples.es: Los muchachos están jugando afuera.
examples.en: The kids are playing outside.

definitions.definition: Dominican. From Quisqueya — a proud name for someone from the DR.

examples.es: Soy quisqueyano y se nota en cómo hablo.
examples.en: I'm Dominican and you can tell from how I talk.

definitions.definition: tangled up; complicated; mixed up in something. Messy situation or messy hair.

examples.es: Ese problema está bien enredado.
examples.en: That problem is really tangled up.

definitions.definition: to go all in; to grind hard. Putting your whole back into the work (Caribbean).

examples.es: Hay que fajarse si queremos terminar hoy.
examples.en: We've got to go all in if we want to finish today.

definitions.definition: to hang out. Chill time with friends — no big agenda.

examples.es: ¿Salimos a janguear esta noche o qué?
examples.en: Are we going out to hang tonight or what?

definitions.definition: gossip; drama. The juicy (or messy) talk going around the barrio.

examples.es: No me metas en ese bochinche, por favor.
examples.en: Don't pull me into that gossip, please.

definitions.definition: a lie; a fib. Something that isn't true — and everybody kind of knows.

examples.es: Eso que te dijeron es un embuste.
examples.en: What they told you is a lie.

definitions.definition: sensitive to cold; always chilly. The person who needs a sweater when it's barely cool.

examples.es: Soy bien friolento — tráeme una cobija.
examples.en: I get cold really easily — bring me a blanket.

definitions.definition: to be overly sweet / cloying. Too much sugar — or too much sweetness in attitude.

examples.es: Ese postre empalaga; no puedo comer más.
examples.en: That dessert is too sweet; I can't eat any more.

definitions.definition: bland; tasteless. Food (or a vibe) with no flavor.

examples.es: La sopa quedó desabrida; le falta sal.
examples.en: The soup came out bland; it needs salt.

definitions.definition: scrawny; skinny; weak-looking. Thin in a "you need to eat" way.

examples.es: Después de estar enfermo se veía escuálido.
examples.en: After being sick he looked really scrawny.

definitions.definition: to dawn; daybreak. When the night ends — or you make it through till morning.

examples.es: Amanecimos hablando en el balcón.
examples.en: We talked on the balcony until dawn.

definitions.definition: to stay up all night. Skipping sleep on purpose (or by accident).

examples.es: Trasnochamos estudiando pa' el examen.
examples.en: We stayed up all night studying for the exam.

definitions.definition: nerve; bold ease; cheek. Talking or acting without shame — confidently loose.

examples.es: Habla con un desparpajo que a mí me da risa.
examples.en: She talks with a bold ease that makes me laugh.

definitions.definition: secondhand embarrassment. Cringing hard for someone else.

examples.es: Me dio vergüenza ajena con ese discurso.
examples.en: I got secondhand embarrassment from that speech.

definitions.definition: to gossip. Trading stories about who's doing what.

examples.es: Nos quedamos chismeando hasta tarde.
examples.en: We stayed up gossiping until late.

definitions.definition: aged; old-school; vintage. Something that's been around — rum, a habit, a memory.

examples.es: Ese ron añejo sabe diferente.
examples.en: That aged rum tastes different.

definitions.definition: to handle yourself; to get by smoothly. Moving through a situation with skill.

examples.es: Ella se desenvuelve bien en cualquier reunión.
examples.en: She handles herself well in any meeting.

definitions.definition: to feel out; to size up. Testing the waters before you commit.

examples.es: Voy a tantear si le interesa el plan.
examples.en: I'm going to feel out whether they're into the plan.

definitions.definition: to scold; to tell off. Getting (or giving) a serious talking-to.

examples.es: Mami me regañó por llegar tarde otra vez.
examples.en: Mom scolded me for showing up late again.

definitions.definition: spoiled; pampered. Used to getting their way — or being treated soft.

examples.es: Ese niño está bien mimado.
examples.en: That kid is really spoiled.

definitions.definition: shameless; bold-faced. No shame about what they just did.

examples.es: Qué descarado pedirte plata después de eso.
examples.en: How shameless to ask you for money after that.

definitions.definition: nosy; meddlesome. Always in other people's business.

examples.es: No seas entrometido; eso no te importa.
examples.en: Don't be nosy; that's none of your business.

definitions.definition: to botch; to do a sloppy job. Rushing something so it comes out half-done.

examples.es: No chapucees la pintura; hazlo bien.
examples.en: Don't botch the paint job; do it right.

definitions.definition: knack; trick; bad habit. A clever workaround — or a stubborn quirk.

examples.es: Tiene una maña pa' abrir frascos sin esfuerzo.
examples.en: He's got a knack for opening jars with no effort.

definitions.definition: laziness; not feeling like it. That heavy "maybe later" energy.

examples.es: Me da pereza salir con este calor.
examples.en: I feel too lazy to go out in this heat.

definitions.definition: to get overwhelmed; to feel smothered. When everything piles up at once.

examples.es: No te agobies; lo hacemos paso a paso.
examples.en: Don't get overwhelmed; we'll do it step by step.

definitions.definition: to waste; to squander. Throwing money (or time) around carelessly.

examples.es: No despilfarres el sueldo en una sola noche.
examples.en: Don't blow the paycheck in a single night.

definitions.definition: to skimp; to hold back. Giving less than you should.

examples.es: No escatimes en la comida si vienen visitas.
examples.en: Don't skimp on the food if guests are coming.

definitions.definition: reluctantly; grudgingly. Doing it — but complaining the whole way.

examples.es: Fui a la reunión a regañadientes.
examples.en: I went to the meeting reluctantly.

definitions.definition: shameless person; rascal. No shame — sometimes funny, sometimes not.

examples.es: Ese sinvergüenza se comió mi almuerzo.
examples.en: That rascal ate my lunch.

definitions.definition: Puerto Rican. From Borikén — a proud name for someone from PR.

examples.es: Soy boricua de corazón, aunque viva afuera.
examples.en: I'm Puerto Rican at heart, even if I live abroad.

definitions.definition: to take for granted. Assuming it'll always be there.

examples.es: No des por sentado que siempre voy a estar disponible.
examples.en: Don't take for granted that I'll always be free.

definitions.definition: to realize; to catch on. The moment it finally clicks.

examples.es: Caí en cuenta de que había dejado las llaves en casa.
examples.en: I realized I'd left the keys at home.

definitions.definition: to throw in someone's face. Reminding them of a favor or a mistake.

examples.es: No me eches en cara lo que te presté.
examples.en: Don't throw in my face what I lent you.

definitions.definition: to be needed; to be missed. When something (or someone) is lacking.

examples.es: Hace falta más hielo pa' las bebidas.
examples.en: We need more ice for the drinks.

definitions.definition: to put your foot in it; to mess up. Saying or doing the wrong thing.

examples.es: Metí la pata cuando hablé sin pensar.
examples.en: I put my foot in it when I spoke without thinking.

definitions.definition: to pull someone's leg; to tease. Messing with you for fun.

examples.es: ¿Me estás tomando el pelo o es verdad?
examples.en: Are you pulling my leg or is it true?

20261222.word: no tener pelos en la lengua
20261222.phonetic: noh teh-NEHR PEH-lohs en lah LEN-gwah

definitions.definition: to not mince words; to be blunt. Saying exactly what you think.

examples.es: Ella no tiene pelos en la lengua; te lo dice directo.
examples.en: She doesn't mince words; she tells you straight.

definitions.definition: to be fed up; to be sick of it. Done with the nonsense.

examples.es: Estoy harto de esa misma excusa.
examples.en: I'm fed up with that same excuse.

definitions.definition: to feel like; to want to. That itch to do something.

examples.es: Tengo ganas de un café bien fuerte.
examples.en: I feel like a really strong coffee.

definitions.definition: to have a good time. Enjoying yourself — simple as that.

examples.es: Que lo pasen bien en la Navidad.
examples.en: Have a good time this Christmas.

definitions.definition: to stand someone up. Not showing when you said you would.

examples.es: Me dejó plantado en el restaurante una hora.
examples.en: He stood me up at the restaurant for an hour.

definitions.definition: to give it your all; to put in the effort. Showing up with energy.

examples.es: Échale ganas al entrenamiento y vas a ver resultados.
examples.en: Give the workout your all and you'll see results.

definitions.definition: to get ahead; to make it through. Pushing forward despite the mess.

examples.es: Con esfuerzo vamos a salir adelante.
examples.en: With effort we're going to make it through.

definitions.definition: to be worth it. The payoff justifies the work.

examples.es: El viaje valió la pena aunque fue largo.
examples.en: The trip was worth it even though it was long.

definitions.definition: to be in the loop; to stay informed. Knowing what's going on.

examples.es: Mantente al tanto de los cambios en el plan.
examples.en: Stay in the loop about changes to the plan.

definitions.definition: to say goodbye; to take your leave. Closing the year — and the conversation.

examples.es: Antes de irme me quiero despedir de todos.
examples.en: Before I go I want to say goodbye to everyone.
